meta.title: ArchiWood Nest — Meet the Best Design Tools
meta.desc: ArchiWood Nest is a SketchUp-based furniture design system: design is manufacturing, WYSIWYG, integrated doors/walls/cabinets, seamless factory connection.
hero.eyebrow: BASED ON SKETCHUP · FURNITURE DESIGN SYSTEM
hero.title:
Meet the Best
Design Tools.
hero.lead1: Built on SketchUp. SketchUp is made for creative design — expressing ideas freely and communicating with clients in real time. ArchiWood Nest fully inherits these strengths.
hero.lead2: A free design workflow for designers, clear presentations for end customers, and more efficient tools for manufacturers.
hero.s2: What You See Is What You Get

more.title: More Core Benefits
more.sub: From craftsmanship to the cloud — built for enterprise needs
more.c1p: Supports cam locks, mortise-and-tenon, Wu-style invisible connectors, Lamello and all mainstream hardware crafts — including mixed production. Supports functional hardware locating holes and connects to domestic and international CNC equipment.
more.c2p: Designed on a cloud architecture from day one. Simple client install, no bulky local database — easy deployment and safer data.
more.c3p: One-click finish change, hardware, and order reports. Ready for production as soon as design is done — shorten the path from proposal to order.
opt.title: Nesting & Production
opt.sub: High yield nesting, labeling, multi-machine routing — boost factory efficiency
opt.n1: High yield nesting, nested layouts, and manual nesting
opt.n1a: High material yield (at least 10% better than peers)
opt.l1a: Color and B&W process label indicators
opt.d1: Panel Saw, CNC Router & Boring Machines
opt.d1a: One nesting suite routes work across panel saws, CNC routers and more
opt.d1b: Export for 5-side / 6-side drills, 3-axis / 4-axis PTP and more
opt.d1c: Fast routing between cutting and CNC drilling equipment

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Trial, customization, deployment, and system requirements.
faq.a1: We do not currently offer a public trial. For evaluation, we provide video demos, detailed manuals, and remote meetings so you can quickly understand the system.
faq.a2: Yes. We can deliver deeper customization such as specific feature modules or special deployment setups.
faq.a3: We offer a third-party real-time rendering system (sold separately). One-click renders, panoramas, and VR — and you can package scenes for clients.
faq.a4: Cloud architecture with a simple client install and no bulky local database. Enterprise clients can use dedicated servers (client-paid); individual users share a regional cloud server.
faq.a5:
Minimum hardware: 8GB RAM, 2GB dedicated GPU, i5 CPU.

OS: Design and production clients support Windows 7+ and macOS.

Software: SketchUp 2017 or later.
faq.a6:
Delivery: Installer is sent immediately after payment.

Returns/refunds: Generally non-refundable after sale, except when our fault prevents equipment connection or normal production — then a full refund applies.
